evidence.quote: asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The statement enacts authority-ranking by declaring a rule that automatically assigns a role (reviewer) upon an action (saving), a rank-based allocation performed as a test assertion.

evidence.quote: exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory as a vehicle solely for the enrollment rule reinforces the authority-ranking allocation — the artifact's purpose is subordinated to carrying the rule that assigns reviewer status.
